name: c13-reload
description: a stored configuration from before C13 (c11-pol-lb-t1-100) loads with the field genes, the gates and the push gene off and runs on

evals.js: const S = await (await fetch('/experiments/tissue/configs/c11-pol-lb-t1-100/snapshot.json')).json(); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, guides: moire.guides.params, g: await moire.genome.get() }
const T = await import('/experiments/tissue/tissue-lab.js'); return await T.measure({ every: 1 })
